name: InputGlyphSwapper
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play input prompt icon — drop on an Image showing something like "Press [E] to interact", and it automatically swaps to a gamepad button icon the moment the player picks up a controller (or back to keyboard/mouse the moment they touch the keyboard or mouse again), tracked by the shared InputDeviceMonitor. This is the "don't hardcode one input method's icons" problem every game that supports both keyboard/mouse AND gamepad eventually runs into.

src_serialized.name: keyboardMouseIcon
src_serialized.tooltip: Shown while the player is using keyboard & mouse.

src_serialized.name: gamepadIcon
src_serialized.tooltip: Shown while the player is using a gamepad.
